packageRules.description: Regenerate Gradle dependency-verification metadata whenever a Maven dependency (AGP, Gradle wrapper, androidx, etc.) changes. Gradle's verification pins SHA-256 hashes of every resolved artifact; without refreshing android/gradle/verification-metadata.xml in the same PR, the TWA build check fails with 'Dependency verification failed' on artifacts like aapt2 that only the real build resolves. The 'assemblePreviewRelease' task resolves the full build classpath (including aapt2, databinding, etc.) so all transitive hashes are recorded. Note: postUpgradeTasks commands run without a shell by default and require the command to match the administrator-configured allowedCommands allowlist. This direct invocation does not require allowShellExecutorForPostUpgradeCommands. workingDirTemplate runs the command from the android/ directory.

Pin TypeScript to ^6.0 until Angular supports TS 7. Angular 22 (incl. 22.1.0-next.6) declares peerDependency typescript >=6.0 <6.1; bumping to TS 7 breaks @angular/compiler-cli readConfiguration with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Error'). Revisit when an Angular release widens its typescript peer range to include 7.x.
